Subject: Post-call recap: AcmeHealth private VPC data flow & next steps

Hi James / SecOps team,

Thanks again for the time today — good discussion. Quick recap and confirmed action items from our call: 

- Scope: Private VPC deployment behind AcmeHealth-managed networking (no public internet ingress to model hosts).
- Data types: Primary traffic will be customer-submitted text (PHI/PII in some flows), hashed identifiers, and some metadata (timestamps, user-agent).
- Retention: AcmeHealth requested token-level logging to support troubleshooting but wants 30-day retention for request/response logs and a separate audit log with 1-year retention; longer retention requires an explicit business justification.
- Logging & egress: No logs may be sent to third-party analytics services. Egress to Redwood's control plane will be limited to telemetry for health and billing (TLS, dedicated peered connection) — we discussed an option to disable billing telemetry for air-gapped installs.
- KV cache / model serving: inference happens on dedicated hosts inside your VPC; KV caches can be configured to be transient-only (no disk persistence).
- On-prem / air-gapped: for fully air-gapped environments we provide an on-prem package; it requires SOW + offline signing for images and a short runbook for updates.

Attachments: acmehealth_vpc_dataflow_diagram.pdf (proposed network boundaries) and redwood_private_deployment_guide.pdf (deployment & controls).

Requested next steps:
1) James: confirm the desired retention windows (30d logs / 1y audit or adjust) and whether security wants billing telemetry disabled.
2) Security: review attached diagram for any disallowed egress or required additional controls (e.g., TLS termination points, private certs).
3) We will set up a technical deep-dive with our infra engineers (Dev Patel + Dylan Brooks) to walk the network diagram and SSO/KMS options.

I can coordinate calendar invites once you confirm availability next week.

Thanks,

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. A couple clarifying questions from our side before we lock calendar time:

1) PII/PHI handling: Are there configuration knobs to redact or tokenize PII before it reaches the model hosts? We ideally want to avoid sending raw PHI into any model if possible.
2) Retention: 30d / 1y sounds reasonable; can you confirm how deletion requests are handled across caches and logs? We need a documented deletion pathway for DSARs.
3) Logs & egress: We cannot allow any outgoing connections to third-party analytics endpoints from the nodes. Can you confirm exactly what the control plane will contact (IP ranges) and whether that can be whitelisted on our side?

Also attaching our internal security questionnaire (short) — please have your infra/security team fill the sections about network flows and key management.

If it helps, we can do the deep-dive on Tue/Wed next week.

James — great questions. Quick answers and proposed owners: 

1) PII/PHI redaction/tokenization: We offer a pre-processing layer that can run in your VPC to strip or pseudonymize fields before traffic hits the model. Dev to advise on supported patterns and whether Regex or schema-based hooks are preferred. (Owner: Dev Patel)

2) Deletion / DSAR handling: Logs and KV caches are configurable. We can provide an automated deletion API that will purge cache entries and redact logs; for audit logs we support redaction markers and can coordinate with your legal team on retention policies. We will document the deletion flow in the SOW. (Owner: Dylan Brooks)

3) Control plane egress: We will provide a small set of egress IP ranges and FQDNs for the control plane and billing telemetry. For Dedicated VPC installs we can disable billing telemetry and use a peered VPC-only telemetry path. For air-gapped installs the control plane is optional/offline. (Owner: Dev Patel)

Next steps:
- Dev + Dylan: can you review James' attached questionnaire and the attached diagram, and provide a short written answer to the three items above plus any network-level concerns by EOD Monday (05 Oct)?
- James/Security: if you can confirm proposed deep-dive times, I'll send calendar invites.

Link to drive with diagram & SOW draft: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1aBcD_example

Thanks — looping in Dev & Dylan for technical follow-up.

Best,
Marissa\n[Quoted message]
